title: Docs
headline: Everything you need to build with Stackra UI.
intro: Accessible, bilingual React and React Native components on HeroUI, with one API on web and mobile. Start with the install, learn the foundations, then pick the component you need.

start.title: Get started
start.install_body: Add @stackra/ui to your app; the web components live in its ./react entry and the mobile ones in ./native.
start.provider: Wrap the app in the provider
start.provider_body: DesignSystemProvider sets the colour scheme, the locale and the reading direction for every component under it.
start.use_body: Every page shows the import, live examples in light, dark, left-to-right and right-to-left, and the API.

sections.foundations_body: Tokens, type, colour, motion and right-to-left text: the rules every component follows.
sections.guides_body: How to choose between components and get the details right.

guides.components_body: By category, with a live preview of each.
guides.studio_body: Pick colours, radius and type in the Theme Studio and export them.
guides.overlays_body: Modal, alert dialog, drawer or route overlay: when to use which.
guides.rtl_body: Arabic layout, mixed-direction text and what mirrors.
guides.llms_body: llms.txt lists every component with its page, for tools that read the docs.
